The course was up to my expectations most of the time. Only problem is that pre-fac students do not need to memorize this much vocabulary or grammar. Instead the focus should be on expressing complex thoughts in english and writing a coherent essay. Otherwise the course feels less like a preparation for the faculty and more like advanced upper intermediate class. The third theme in materials given to us is a good example to show what the school should do. The pre-fac course loses to much time on trying to teach the lower level students. Instead of wasting time on students who does not have the motivation nor the level to study shcool should increase debates , essay writing and other skills which are more neccesery to succeed in our faculty. Especially pre faculty course should be a simulation of the faculty. In addition the school should definitely change its rootangle system , completely remove it if possible.
